title: Calendar Filter – Teacher Role – BO Calendar – Course Selected – All System-Wide Classes Listed

preconditions:
- Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE
- Course A has 3 classes: Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma
- Lesson G1 (Class Alpha, Teacher T1 assigned), G2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta, Teacher T2 only), G3 (Class Beta, Teacher T2 only), G4 (Class Gamma, Teacher T2 only) in current week
- Logged in as Teacher T1 (CPU login / bo_teacher role) to the Back Office

title: Calendar Filter – Teacher Role – BO Calendar – Class Checked – Calendar Filtered Correctly for Teacher
description: BR-14, BR-4 — Decision Table — Confirms that when a teacher checks a class, the calendar applies both the class filter AND the teacher scope: only that teacher's lessons containing the selected class are shown.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- Course A has 3 classes; Lesson G1 (Class Alpha, Teacher T1), G2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta, Teacher T2 only), G3 (Class Beta, Teacher T2 only), G4 (Class Gamma, Teacher T2 only)\n- Logged in as Teacher T1 (CPU login) to the Back Office
steps_actions:
1. Log in as Teacher T1 and open BO Calendar
2. Select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter
3. Check Class Alpha
4. Observe the calendar
steps_result:
1. Only Lesson G1 is visible (teacher scope: Teacher T1's assigned lessons only)
2. Class section appears; Class Alpha, Class Beta, and Class Gamma are listed
3. Class Alpha is checked (active filter)
4. Lesson G1 is shown (has Class Alpha AND assigned to Teacher T1); Lesson G2 is NOT shown (has Class Alpha but Teacher T1 is not assigned — teacher scope still applied)
